plugins.description: Forecastable AI Team: Eva, your AI Partner Manager Assistant, and Alex, your AI Chief Partnerships Officer. Eva turns partner decisions into work that actually happens: meeting prep, play assignment and forwardable handoffs, partner success plans, commitment tracking and chases, staleness sweeps, and a daily triage of action items into plans. Alex assesses your partner program against the Valuation Certainty Blueprint, reports what moved, and gives a straight call on the hard questions. Both draft for your approval and never send on your behalf.
